title: Summer Workshops 2027
about: The Aspen Center for Physics in Aspen invites applications for its summer 2027 workshops and individual research stays. Everyone, including organizers and speakers, must apply; the deadline for summer applications is January 15, 2027.
requirements: Everyone, including workshop organizers and speakers, must submit an application
card_alt: Card for Summer Workshops 2027 at the Aspen Center for Physics, Aspen, United States; apply by 15 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline in New York, not Aspen.
